work.description: Epistle CCCXCIII to Jean-François-Marie Le Pappe de Trévern, bishop of Strasbourg (address LF74368–74370, protocol GREGORIUS PP. XVI LF74373, salutation LF74376–74377), acknowledges his pastoral letter against the opinions of the priest Bautain and his followers and hopes for their return to sound doctrine, ending with its own 20 December 1834 closing at LF74405–74408. Its foot-note LF74411, the volume signature LF74414 and sheet signature 62 (LF74417) close the last text page (leaf 507); the next OCR line LF74420 begins the volume's INDEX RERUM on leaf 509. It is the last act of volume 1; nothing continues beyond the claim end. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI at LF74373–74373; the source closing at LF74405–74408 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima decembris mil- lesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quarto, pon- tificatus Nostri anno quarto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
